facts.fact: Guinea's territorial administration minister told the CNT law commission on 29 March 2026 that the ministry, through ONECI, is digitising civil status and setting up both the national register of natural persons (RNPP) and the national civil status register (RNEC), with digital solutions deployed in 28 communes in 2025.

GIN.note: No count or share of people enrolled is given.
No ID number at birth is stated.
Nothing on who builds or maintains the system beyond ONECI pursuing it.
The biometric electoral file is mentioned but not said to be drawn from or keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: The minister said ONECI is setting up the national register of natural persons (RNPP), with a national-scale biometric census carried out in 2025.
